# TC.Config.Read.SectionFilter

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.Config.Read.SectionFilter"></a>

### TC.Config.Read.SectionFilter

Indexed native section filter. Dense array with unique slot indexes and effective identities. The minimum defaults to 0. The current adapter uses registered nauvis for item import_from by default when available. The maximum cannot be less than the minimum. A nonzero minimum in an object filter requires explicit exact quality. Section filters also require index. Duplicate slots and effective identities are refused. Unknown fields are refused. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

### import_from (optional)

Installed import location. The current adapter uses registered nauvis for item imports by default when available. Use an installed space_location name, not a native object. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
string
```

### index

Explicit native filter slot index. A dense array can contain sparse slot indexes, but each index must be unique. Finite integer. Domain: 1..128. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
integer
```

### max (optional)

Maximum requested count. This cannot be less than a supplied minimum. Finite integer. Domain: 0..4294967295. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
TC.Config.Read.ItemCountType
```

### min

Minimum requested count. The default is zero. A nonzero filtered count requires exact quality. Finite integer. Domain: -2147483648..2147483647. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
integer
```

### minimum_delivery_count (optional)

Minimum native delivery quantity for this filter. Finite integer. Domain: 0..4294967295. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
TC.Config.Read.ItemCountType
```

### value

Signal filter. An absent value means an empty slot, not a numeric zero signal. Unknown fields are refused. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
TC.Config.Read.SignalFilter
```
